requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL execute dynamic halfcode code entries with output = fn(runtime, input, config).

case.given: a dynamic code entry with a callable export
case.then: the export SHALL receive runtime, input, and config in that order

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL execute selected-instance code entries with output = fn(runtime, instanceRefs, input, config).

case.given: a selected element or instance reference collection
case.then: the export SHALL receive runtime, instanceRefs, input, and config in that order

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL use injected symbol resolution instead of baking module loading policy into the DSL.

case.given: a code reference declared in a bundle
case.then: the runtime SHALL resolve its symbol through an injected resolver

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL return runtime diagnostics for non-callable symbols and thrown execution failures.

case.given: a resolved export is not callable
case.then: the runtime SHALL return a structured diagnostic

case.given: a callable export throws during execution
case.then: the runtime SHALL return a structured execution diagnostic
